name: Vampire Counts
source: Warhammer Armies: Vampire Counts (5th edition), army list pp.59-67, special characters pp.70-79 (book page numbers)
keywordsSource: Special rule keywords from the Liber Mortis (pp.49-58) and army list

pools.name: Vampire Powers
pools.oneTypeMessage: All the Vampires in the army must come from the same bloodline (p.26).

itemNeeds.message: only a Vampire with the Pure Blood power may carry the Carstein Ring (p.27)

rules.message: The army must be led by one General: a Vampire Lord or Vampire Count, or a special character who replaces him (p.62).
Only one Battle Standard Bearer is allowed (p.63).
One Banshee for every full 1,000 points in the army (p.66).
No more units of Vampire Bats than Zombie, Skeleton, Grave Guard, Ghoul and Wight Cavalry units combined (p.66).
Up to five Vampire Bats form one unit, six to ten up to two units, and so on (p.66).
Half-cost Bat Swarms: at most one per Vampire in the army; any more cost 100 points each (p.67).

entries.name: Vampire General
entries.rulesText: Fear, Immune to psychology, May march, Break tests when alone
entries.notes: Necromantic, Battle or Dark Magic. Choose one Vampire Power from the army's bloodline; a Lord may take up to two more, a Count one more (p.62).

entries.name: Vampire
entries.rulesText: Fear, Immune to psychology, May march, Break tests when alone
entries.notes: Every Vampire takes one power from the army's bloodline; a Count may take a second (p.62).

entries.name: Necromancer
entries.rulesText: Living (not Undead unless leading Undead)
entries.notes: Necromancers may take a double-handed weapon or a halberd but no armour (p.62).

entries.name: Battle Standard Bearer
entries.equipmentText: Sword or other hand weapon; battle standard

variants.name: Vampire Thrall
variants.rulesText: Fear, Immune to psychology, May march, Break tests when alone

variants.name: Wight Lord
variants.rulesText: Fear, Immune to psychology, Wight weapons (D3 wounds), Unbreakable (extra casualties)

entries.notes: His one magic item may be a magic standard. A Vampire Thrall takes one power from the army's bloodline (p.63).

entries.name: Undead Champion

variants.name: Wight Lord
variants.rulesText: Fear, Immune to psychology, Wight weapons (D3 wounds), Unbreakable (extra casualties)

variants.name: Wraith
variants.rulesText: Terror, Ethereal, Immune to psychology, Chill attack, Unbreakable (extra casualties)

entries.equipmentText: Wight Lord: sword or other hand weapon. Wraith: double-handed scythe, no armour

attachTo.label: Leading
attachTo.requiredMessage: an Undead Champion must lead a regiment of Wight Cavalry, Zombies, Skeletons or Grave Guard
attachTo.hint: a Wight Lord may ride a Nightmare (+2, barding +4) only when leading Wight Cavalry

entries.notes: Undead Champions need not be equipped like their regiment and are paid from the Characters allowance (pp.59-60).

entries.name: Skeleton Champion

attachTo.label: Leading
attachTo.requiredMessage: a Skeleton Champion must lead a regiment of Skeleton Warriors

entries.rulesText: Fear, Immune to psychology, Unbreakable (extra casualties), No march

entries.name: Wight Cavalry
entries.rulesText: Fear, Immune to psychology, Wight weapons (D3 wounds), Unbreakable (extra casualties), No march

entries.name: Grave Guard
entries.rulesText: Fear, Immune to psychology, Wight weapons (D3 wounds), Unbreakable (extra casualties), No march

entries.name: Skeleton Warriors
entries.rulesText: Fear, Immune to psychology, Unbreakable (extra casualties), No march

entries.name: Zombies
entries.rulesText: Fear, Immune to psychology, Unbreakable (extra casualties), No march, Horde (always lap round)

entries.name: Spirit Host
entries.rulesText: Ethereal, Fear, Immune to psychology, Unbreakable (extra casualties), No march
entries.notes: All Spirit Host bases in the army fight as one unit, of any size (p.65).

entries.name: Ghouls
entries.rulesText: Fear, May march, No Break test while outnumbering the enemy
entries.notes: Ghouls have no banners or musicians and cannot be led or joined by characters (pp.53, 65).

entries.name: Dire Wolves
entries.rulesText: Fear, Immune to psychology, Unbreakable (extra casualties), No march, Extra attack on the charge
entries.notes: Any pack may include one Doom Wolf (25 pts), treated as a Champion but carrying no magic items (pp.55, 65).

entries.name: Vampire Bats
entries.rulesText: Fly, Skirmish, Fear, Immune to psychology, Unbreakable (extra casualties)
entries.notes: Up to five Bats form one unit, six to ten one or two units, and so on (p.66).

entries.name: Banshee
entries.rulesText: Ethereal, Ghostly Howl (8"), Fear, Immune to psychology
entries.notes: Banshees never form or join units; each fights alone (p.66).

entries.name: Black Coach
entries.rulesText: Chariot, Wraith: Ethereal, Terror, Chill attack, Evocation of Death
entries.notes: May carry a magic standard (no combat resolution bonus); the Wraith may not carry magic items (p.66).

entries.name: Zombie Dragon
entries.rulesText: Fly, Terror, Scaly skin 5+, Pestilential breath, Cloud of flies

entries.name: Bat Swarms
entries.notes: All Bat Swarms form a single unit. One half-cost base (50) per Vampire in the army; any more cost 100 (p.67).

entries.name: Winged Nightmare
entries.rulesText: Fly, +2 Strength on the charge

entries.name: Dieter Helsnicht, Doom Lord
entries.equipmentText: Chaos Runesword, Staff of Flaming Death, Power Scroll; rides a Manticore
entries.rulesText: Level 4 wizard (4 spells, Dark and Necromantic), Living (not Undead unless leading Undead), Manticore needs no reaction rolls
entries.notes: Replaces the General. His 690 points include his Manticore and magic items (p.70).

entries.name: Heinrich Kemmler, the Lichemaster
entries.equipmentText: Chaos Tomb Blade, Skull Staff, Cloak of the Lichemaster; on foot
entries.rulesText: Great Necromancer (Necromantic spells always reinforced), Living (not Undead unless leading Undead)
entries.notes: Replaces the General; an army led by Kemmler may include Krell (p.71).

entries.name: Krell
entries.equipmentText: Black Axe of Krell, Armour of Protection (as heavy armour, second 4+ save); on foot
entries.rulesText: Undead, Terror, Immune to psychology

requires.message: Krell may only be included if the army is led by Heinrich Kemmler (p.72).

entries.notes: An independent character; he does not have to lead or join a unit (p.72).

entries.name: Mannfred von Carstein
entries.equipmentText: Ebony Staff, Cursed Parchment; rides a Nightmare
entries.rulesText: Level 4 wizard (4 spells, recasts Necromantic spells), Powers: Unbending Willpower, Call Winds, Fear, Immune to psychology, May march, Break tests when alone
entries.notes: Von Carstein bloodline. May lead the army, replacing the General (p.73).

entries.name: Melkhior the Ancient
entries.equipmentText: Painbringer, Grimoire Necronium, Black Cloak of Lahmia; rides a Winged Nightmare (flies)
entries.rulesText: Level 4 wizard (4 spells), Powers: Supernatural Horror, Death Incarnate, Nehekhara's Noble Blood, Forbidden Lore, Master of the Black Arts, Terror, Stupidity
entries.notes: Necrarch bloodline. If included he is the General (p.74).

entries.name: Neferata, Queen of Mysteries
entries.equipmentText: Dagger of Jet, Ruby of Lahmia, Bastet; on foot
entries.rulesText: Level 3 wizard (2 spells + Shadowblood), Powers: Night Creature, Seduction, Innocence Lost, Blood Kiss, Fear, Immune to psychology, May march, Break tests when alone
entries.notes: Lahmia bloodline. Replaces the General (p.76).

entries.name: Vlad von Carstein
entries.equipmentText: Carstein Ring, Wailing Blade; on foot
entries.rulesText: Level 3 wizard (2 spells), All Von Carstein powers, Undying love, Fear, Immune to psychology, May march, Break tests when alone
entries.notes: Von Carstein bloodline. Replaces the General; an army led by Vlad may include Isabella (p.78).

entries.name: Isabella von Carstein
entries.rulesText: Powers: Bat Form, Transfix, Undying love, Fear, Immune to psychology, May march, Break tests when alone

requires.message: Isabella may only be included if the army is led by Vlad von Carstein (p.78).

entries.notes: Von Carstein bloodline (p.78).

entries.name: Walach Harkon, Grand Master of the Blood Dragons
entries.equipmentText: Crimson Blade, Blood Chalice, Blood Dragon Standard, shield, heavy armour; rides a barded Nightmare
entries.rulesText: Level 3 wizard (2 spells), Powers: Doomrider, Strength of Steel, Might of Arms, Red Fury (in his profile), Fear, Immune to psychology, May march, Break tests when alone
entries.notes: Blood Dragon bloodline. Replaces both the General and the Battle Standard Bearer (p.79).
